question: Who makes Grove Avocado Oil brand owner
markdown:
Grove Avocado Oil
is made and owned by
Avocado Oil New Zealand Limited
, a company based in Te Puna, Bay of Plenty, New Zealand. It was originally established in 2000 by a collective group of local avocado orchardists and growers.

Company Background
Founding:
Formed in the year 2000 by local New Zealand fruit growers.
Location:
Te Puna, Bay of Plenty, New Zealand.
Key Leadership:
Managed by executives including James Greenlees (General Manager / Avocado Trust Chairman) and Brian Richardson (Executive Director).
Product:
Cold-pressed 100% pure extra virgin and infused avocado oils derived from local Hass avocados.
